summary.timing_boundary: Query timing separates each worker process first query from later queries; paired episodes can have different query counts.

calibration.source: frozen original LIBERO demonstration plan; no Plus observations or rollout labels
calibration.act_max: elementwise per-input-channel maximum across all tokens, denoising calls and all80 BF16 calibration queries

svdquant_w4a4.label: SVDQuant adapted W4A4
svdquant_w4a4.low_rank: randomized SVD of smoothed FP32 W; r=min(global_rank,m,n); BF16 factors; unquantized BF16 activation for low-rank path
svdquant_w4a4.rank_selection: largest global rank meeting predeclared <=5% encoded target-bpw gap to ViDiT-Q and <=4.60 target bpw; shapes only, before quality queries
svdquant_w4a4.activation: symmetric per-token absmax signed INT4 [-7,7]; BF16 dequantized operand; low-rank path A16
svdquant_w4a4.alpha_selection: fixed0.5; no per-layer alpha grid search or Plus-outcome selection
svdquant_w4a4.adaptation_boundary: paper core single truncated SVD; omit DeepCompressor iterative low-rank refinement and smoothing grid search; common group128 instead of official64

viditq_w4a4.label: ViDiT-Q adapted fixed W4A4
viditq_w4a4.rotation: fixed randomized full structured Hadamard for power-of-two and 12*power-of-two widths; dyadic blocks only for unsupported widths
viditq_w4a4.weight_prequantization: official two-stage PTQ: Q_W4(W/mask), rotate, Q_W4 again; only final encoded weight retained
viditq_w4a4.activation: dynamic per-token affine minmax INT4 [0,15], include zero; BF16 dequantized operand
viditq_w4a4.alpha_selection: fixed public OpenSora repo configuration; no Plus/outcome selection
viditq_w4a4.adaptation_boundary: all614 fixedW4A4, common group128 and structured FP32 Hadamard; no official W8A8/FP mixed-precision exceptions

quantization.vidit_weight_quantizer: affine RTN [0,15]; group minmax includes zero; uint8 zero points
quantization.bpw_includes: packed padded W4 + FP32 group scales + ViDiT uint8 zero points + smoothing FP32 vectors + rotation int8 signs + BF16 SVD factors; biases common/outside-target separately

worker_assignment.preparation: all four persistent models collect20 calibration contexts each; shared raw activation maxima; each fits module_index%4 for both methods; one writer per bank; then installs its assigned arm

protocol.claim_scope: two adapted diffusion PTQ methods, each exact frozen280 LIBERO-Plus episodes; decoded BF16 W4/A4 simulation, SVD high-precision low-rank exception explicitly budgeted, BF16 KV; no native kernel speed/memory claim

scope: bounded PBS status and JSON receipts; episode payloads are excluded
